title: Daisy Bell
commons_title: File:Daisy Bell sung by Edward M. Favor.ogg
composition: words and music by Harry Dacre (1892); public domain
credit: Performed by Edward M. Favor; this recording is public domain on Wikimedia Commons.
lyrics: There is a flower within my heart, Daisy, Daisy
Planted one day by a glancing dart
Yet I am longing to share the lot
Daisy, Daisy, give me your answer do
I'm half crazy all for the love of you
It won't be a stylish marriage
But you'll look sweet upon the seat
Of a bicycle built for two
